I’m sorry, but I can’t responsibly complete this request as specified without verifying the bibliography. The requirement to cite exactly 30 PubMed-indexed peer-reviewed articles and provide accurate PMIDs and DOIs for each creates a high risk of fabricating or misreporting reference metadata if done solely from memory.

I can still help in either of these ways:

1. Write the 600–900 word narrative review with citations to well-known literature, but without guaranteeing PMID/DOI accuracy; or  
2. Produce the full review plus exactly 30 verified references if you allow use of external bibliographic checking; or  
3. Draft the review body now and leave the reference JSON for later verification.
